sets.title: Quick Quiz
sets.description: Choose the correct preposition for each location
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите правильный предлог для каждого места

items.explanation: Cities use в for location: в Петербурге (in Petersburg).
Улица (street/outside) is one of the words that always uses на: на улице.

items.promptEnglish: The letter is on the table.
items.explanation: На + prepositional is used for surfaces: на столе (on the table).

items.promptEnglish: Grandma is in the hospital right now.
items.explanation: Buildings and enclosed spaces use в: в больнице (in the hospital).

items.promptEnglish: He works at the post office.
items.hint: The post office is an idiomatic на-word.
items.explanation: Почта (post office) always uses на: на почте. This is an exception to memorize.

items.promptEnglish: The students are sitting in the lecture hall.
items.explanation: Аудитория (lecture hall) is an enclosed room, so use в: в аудитории.

items.promptEnglish: We are waiting at the train station.
items.hint: The station is an idiomatic на-word.
items.explanation: Вокзал (train station) always uses на: на вокзале. Memorize this exception.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The cat is sleeping on the sofa.
minimalPairs.explanation: The cat is on the surface of the sofa, so use на: на диване.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The milk is in the fridge.
minimalPairs.explanation: The milk is inside the fridge, so use в: в холодильнике.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She is at work right now.
minimalPairs.explanation: Работа always uses на: на работе. This is an idiomatic exception.

sets.title: Fill and Sort
sets.description: Fill in prepositions and sort places by their preposition
sets.descriptionRussian: Вставьте предлоги и рассортируйте места по предлогам

blanks: Книги стоят _____ шкафу. (The books are in the cupboard.)
Мы гуляем _____ парке. (We are walking in the park.)
Тарелка _____ столе. (The plate is on the table.)
Врач _____ кабинете. (The doctor is in the office.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: в for enclosed spaces; на for surfaces and idiomatic words like работа
explanations: Работа always uses на: на работе.
Шкаф (cupboard) is enclosed, so use в: в шкафу.
Парк uses в for location: в парке.
Стол (table) is a surface, so use на: на столе.
Кабинет (office) is a room, so use в: в кабинете.

sets.title: Find the Mistakes
sets.description: Spot the wrong preposition and test tricky location rules
sets.descriptionRussian: Найдите неправильный предлог и проверьте сложные правила

errorCorrection.hint: The post office is one of the idiomatic на-words.
errorCorrection.explanation: Почта (post office) always uses на, not в: на почте.
Вокзал (train station) always uses на: на вокзале. This must be memorized.

errorCorrection.hint: Milk is stored inside the fridge, not on top.
errorCorrection.explanation: Milk goes inside the fridge, so use в: в холодильнике. На холодильнике means on top of the fridge.

errorCorrection.hint: Work always takes на for location.
errorCorrection.explanation: Работа always uses на for location: на работе, not в работе.

items.promptEnglish: We are going to the station.
items.hint: Station is always an на-word, even for direction.
items.explanation: Вокзал uses на for both location (на вокзале) and direction (на вокзал).

items.promptEnglish: He is going to the store.
items.hint: The store is a building - direction into.
items.explanation: Магазин uses в for direction: в магазин (accusative, direction into).

items.hint: Work uses на for both location and direction.
items.explanation: Работа always uses на: на работу (direction), на работе (location).

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: A mixed round covering all preposition rules for location
sets.descriptionRussian: Смешанный раунд по всем правилам предлогов места

patternRecognition.sentence: на работе, на почте, на вокзале, на улице
patternRecognition.question: What do these location phrases have in common?
options: They all use на even though they are places you go inside
They all use the accusative case
patternRecognition.answer: They all use на even though they are places you go inside
patternRecognition.explanation: These are idiomatic exceptions: работа, почта, вокзал, and улица all use на instead of the expected в. They must be memorized.

patternRecognition.sentence: в доме, в школе, в магазине, в библиотеке
patternRecognition.question: Why do all of these locations use в?
options: They are enclosed spaces (buildings or rooms)
patternRecognition.answer: They are enclosed spaces (buildings or rooms)
patternRecognition.explanation: В is used for enclosed spaces like buildings, rooms, and containers. These all follow the standard rule.

patternRecognition.sentence: в Москве, в России, в Европе
patternRecognition.question: What type of locations are these?
patternRecognition.explanation: Cities, countries, and continents use в: в Москве (in Moscow), в России (in Russia), в Европе (in Europe).

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The phone is in the bag.
minimalPairs.explanation: The phone is inside the bag (enclosed), so use в: в сумке.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The vase is on the shelf.
minimalPairs.explanation: The vase is on the surface of the shelf, so use на: на полке.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: My brother is at work right now.
minimalPairs.explanation: Работа always uses на for location: на работе.
Университет is a building/institution, so use в: в университете.

blanks: Продукты _____ холодильнике. (The groceries are in the fridge.)
Собака спит _____ полу. (The dog is sleeping on the floor.)
Сестра _____ концерте. (My sister is at the concert.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: в for inside containers; на for surfaces and events
explanations: Холодильник (fridge) is enclosed, so use в: в холодильнике.
Пол (floor) is a surface, so use на: на полу.
Events like concerts use на: на концерте.
